access.title: Preventive & statutory checks need plant.view
access.body: Ask an administrator for a role that sees the plant (Maintenance, Production manager or Safety officer).

band.label: Preventive & statutory checks
band.printHint: Any period up to three years, with the reports, in a new tab.
band.exportHint: Goes to the check register: Export ▾ in its toolbar, or Export N of the rows you choose.

tile.title: What is due
tile.failed: The tiles could not be read

OVERDUE.label: Checks overdue
OVERDUE.hint: Past their due date: shows them in Plans

DUE_SOON.label: Due in 30 days
DUE_SOON.hint: Due within 30 days: shows them in Plans

REPORTS_MISSING.label: Reports missing
REPORTS_MISSING.hint: Results in force with no report on file: shows them in the register

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.label: Statutory checks · {site}
calendar.windowList: {from} – {to} (the last 5 weeks and the next year)
calendar.failed: The calendar could not be read
calendar.empty: Start with New plan: pick a machine and a check type. The check types come from Plant settings.
calendar.dragHint: Drag a due check onto another day to move it (you give the reason). The keyboard way: open the check, then Move a check (m).

plans.title: Plans
plans.note: Each recurring check (preventive maintenance by time or use comes later).
plans.label: Check plans
plans.failed: The plans could not be read
plans.none: New plan puts a machine's statutory check on the calendar.
plans.noneFiltered: No plan is in this state now. Clear the tile to see every plan.
plans.noneEnded: A plan ends when it is replaced or its machine leaves.

law.plain: The law or standard this check rests on, as Plant settings keeps it. Its results are kept {years} years (at least 3: D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 71).

outcomeHint.PASSED_WITH_REMARKS: In use, with something to put right: say what.
outcomeHint.FAILED: Not safe as it is: say what failed.

register.title: Check register
register.label: Check register
register.law: Every result of a periodic check of work equipment is kept at least three years, and shown to an inspector on request.
register.failed: The check register could not be read
register.none: Record a check result once a check is done: it stays here at least three years.
register.noneFiltered: No result matches. Clear the filter to see the whole register.

report.title: Check report · {check} · {machine} · {date}
report.held: Wait for the report to be read.
report.preview: A preview, made now and stored nowhere. Keep in the register keeps it as the result's document.
report.keptSame: Already kept as version {version} ({date}): the same contents.
report.sealNoRight: The kept copy's fingerprint needs files.read.
report.sealFailed: The kept copy's fingerprint could not be read: open the copy instead.

reportLong.missing: No report on file: upload the body's or the technician's report.
reportLong.byCorrected: The report is on the result this one corrects.
reportLong.notNeeded: No report on this result: a later result corrects it.

facts.notReminded: Not yet for this due date
facts.planNext: The plan is due next on {date}

plan.anySite: Machines of every site you work at
plan.machineHint: A machine in use (a retired one takes no plan).
plan.machinePlaceholder: Type an asset number, make or model
plan.typeHint: From Plant settings: this machine's class, or any machine.
plan.typeNone: No active check type for this machine: add one in Plant settings.
plan.firstDueHint: The first check of this plan; it is never due before this day.
plan.reminderHint: How many days before the due date the reminder goes (0 to 365).
plan.bodyHint: An organisation of the company or the group (the accredited inspector).
plan.ownerHint: Who looks after this plan: you or the site's maintenance office.
plan.replaceTitle: A plan for this check exists
plan.replaceBody: Change that plan from its window, or end it here and start this one in its place.
plan.replace: End the current plan and start this one
plan.noResults: No result recorded on this plan yet.
plan.noFiles: No report on file for this plan's results.

result.title: Record a check result
result.pickSubtitle: Pick the machine and the check
result.typeHint: Its active plan is used when it has one (its next due date moves).
result.planAuto: If this machine has an active plan for this check, the result goes on it and moves its next due date.
result.correctsBody: A result never changes: this one is recorded beside it and named as its correction. Fix what was wrong and say why.
result.dateHint: Today or before: a check is recorded once it is done.
result.byHint: As on the report: the outside body or the inspector (words).
result.remarksFailed: Say what failed: the job and the lock say it too.
result.makeJobFailed: A safety job, priority 1, naming this check (Maintenance jobs).
result.makeJobRemarks: A corrective job, priority 2, naming this check (Maintenance jobs).
result.lockedAlready: The machine is locked as unsafe already: it stays do-not-use until a technician signs it safe.
result.nextDueHint: Leave it empty and the plan is due next on {date}.
result.nextDueNone: Leave it empty and the plan's interval decides.
result.reportHint: The body's or the technician's report: PDF, an office document or a scan (20 MB each).
result.reportAfter: Sent once the result is saved

lock.title: Lock {machine} as unsafe
lock.reach: The machine goes do-not-use: on its station, on the tablet and on every list; no work is sent to it.
lock.reversal: Only a technician signs it safe again (Owner answer H1).
lock.joins: The lock joins this check's open job when it has one.
lock.law: Work equipment is kept safe; a machine found unsafe is not used until it is put right.
lock.noteHint: Optional: what to look at first.

move.title: Move a check
move.now: Due now on {date}; never before the plan's first due date, {first}.
move.dateHint: The day the check is due instead.
move.reasonHint: Kept with the change (the outside body's visit moved, the machine is away…). The reminder goes again for the new date.

done.planReplaced: The old plan ended; the new plan for {machine} is created.
done.moved: {machine}: the check is due on {date} now.
done.savedLock: Result saved; the machine is locked as unsafe.
done.savedJobLock: Result saved; job {number} made and the machine locked as unsafe.
done.locked: The machine is locked as unsafe: a technician signs it safe again.

held.interval: Give an interval from 1 to at most ten years.
held.reminder: Give a lead time of 0 to 365 days.
held.replaceReason: Say why the current plan ends.
held.performedOn: Choose the day the check was done.
held.future: A check is recorded once it is done: the day is today or before.
held.performedBy: Say who did the check, as on the report.
held.performedByLong: Who did it is too long.
held.nextDue: The next due date is after the day the check was done.
held.correctionReason: Say why the result is corrected.
held.parties: Picking an outside body needs parties.view.
held.noneDue: Choose a check's next due date.
held.onlyNextDue: Only a check's next due date moves (a later check follows it; a check done never moves).
held.jobOpen: Job {number} of this check is still open.
held.jobNotNow: No job may be made of this result now.
held.lockNotNow: This result may not lock the machine now.
held.correctNotNow: This result may not be corrected now.
held.reportNotNow: A report may not be added to this result now.

refusal.TYPE_TAKEN: That check type code exists already.
refusal.TYPE_RETIRED: That check type is retired: it takes no new plan. Make it active again in Plant settings, or pick another.
refusal.TYPE_OTHER_CLASS: That check type is for another class of machine: pick one of this machine's class, or one for any machine.
refusal.TOO_MANY_TYPES: There are too many check types: retire those no longer used first.
refusal.MACHINE_RETIRED: The machine is retired: it takes no new plan or result.
refusal.PLAN_EXISTS: This machine has a plan for this check already.
refusal.PLAN_ENDED: This plan is ended: it never changes and takes no more results.
refusal.PLAN_OTHER: The plan named is of another machine or check type.
refusal.BEFORE_FIRST_DUE: A check of this plan is never due before its first due date: pick that day or later.
refusal.SAME_DATE: The check is due on that day already: pick another date.
refusal.CORRECTED_ALREADY: This result was corrected already: correct the newer result instead.
refusal.CORRECTS_OTHER: A correction is of a result of the same machine and check type.
refusal.NO_JOB_FOR_PASSED: A check that passed makes no job: make one by hand in Maintenance jobs if the machine needs it.
refusal.LOCK_NEEDS_FAILED: Only a failed check locks the machine from here: report it unsafe in Machine requests if it is.
refusal.JOB_EXISTS: A job made of this check is still open: open that job instead.
refusal.LOCKED_ALREADY: The machine is locked as unsafe already: it stays do-not-use until a technician signs it safe.
refusal.CLASS_INACTIVE: The machine's class is no longer used.
refusal.LOCKED_UNSAFE: The machine is locked as unsafe: a technician signs it safe first.
refusal.H1_HELD: The site's rule says who may lock a machine: this lock is held by it.
refusal.LOCK_NOT_ALLOWED: The site does not allow this lock from here.

problem.read: We could not read it. Try again in a moment.
problem.refused: The factory refused this. Read the page again and check what changed.
problem.field: A field is not right: check what you typed.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not right: check the fields.
problem.signedOut: You are signed out: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.conflict: It changed meanwhile: read it again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
problem.contract: The answer was not what the page expects: tell the administrator.
problem.unavailable: The factory does not answer right now. Try again in a moment.
problem.noAnswer: No answer came back: whether it was done is not known.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
problem.unknownHint: Read the page again before you try once more: it may have been saved.
problem.uploadAfter: The result is saved, but its report could not be sent: add it again here.
problem.file: The file could not be opened. Try again in a moment.
problem.more: The next rows could not be read. Try again.

print.title: Check register
print.note: Every result of the period, by machine and day, with the report on file. A corrected result names the result that corrects it.
print.truncated: This period holds more results than one paper shows: choose a shorter period.
print.heldOrder: The period ends on or after its first day.
print.heldLong: At most three years at once.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.open: Open the plan or the result
keys.move: Move a check (in the Plan window)
